question: How many products do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products

question: List all suppliers and their countries.
gold_sql: SELECT name, country FROM suppliers

question: How many products are in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category

question: How many sales transactions are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales

question: What is the most expensive product?
gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which suppliers are based in China?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE country='China'

question: What is the average unit price of Electronics products?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM products WHERE category='Electronics'

question: Show all products supplied by Nordic Textiles.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.id=p.supplier_id WHERE s.name='Nordic Textiles'

question: Top 5 products by total units sold.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(s.quantity) AS units FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.id=s.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which category sold the most units?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(s.quantity) AS units FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.id=s.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1

question: Total units sold in 2025.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM sales WHERE strftime('%Y',sale_date)='2025'

question: Total revenue per category.
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(s.quantity*p.unit_price) FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.id=s.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question: Which products have never been sold?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales s WHERE s.product_id=p.id)

question: How many units did we purchase in total for each supplier?
gold_sql: SELECT su.name, SUM(pu.quantity) FROM purchases pu JOIN products p ON p.id=pu.product_id JOIN suppliers su ON su.id=p.supplier_id GROUP BY su.id

question: What is the profit margin percentage of each product? Highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT name, (unit_price-unit_cost)*100.0/unit_price AS margin FROM products ORDER BY margin DESC

question: Monthly units sold in 2026.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',sale_date) AS month, SUM(quantity) FROM sales WHERE strftime('%Y',sale_date)='2026' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Which suppliers supply more than 5 products?
gold_sql: SELECT su.name FROM suppliers su JOIN products p ON p.supplier_id=su.id GROUP BY su.id HAVING COUNT(*)>5

question: How many units of Laptop were sold?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(s.quantity) FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE p.name='Laptop'

question: What is the current stock of each product?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COALESCE(b.bought,0)-COALESCE(s.sold,0) AS stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS bought FROM purchases GROUP BY product_id) b ON b.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS sold FROM sales GROUP BY product_id) s ON s.product_id=p.id

question: Which products have negative stock (sold more than purchased)?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COALESCE(b.bought,0)-COALESCE(s.sold,0) AS stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS bought FROM purchases GROUP BY product_id) b ON b.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS sold FROM sales GROUP BY product_id) s ON s.product_id=p.id WHERE COALESCE(b.bought,0)-COALESCE(s.sold,0) < 0

question: Which 3 products have the highest stock?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COALESCE(b.bought,0)-COALESCE(s.sold,0) AS stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS bought FROM purchases GROUP BY product_id) b ON b.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS sold FROM sales GROUP BY product_id) s ON s.product_id=p.id ORDER BY stock DESC LIMIT 3

question: Total profit (revenue minus cost of goods sold) per category, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(s.quantity*(p.unit_price-p.unit_cost)) AS profit FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.id=s.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY profit DESC

question: Revenue by quarter for 2025.
gold_sql: SELECT 'Q'||((CAST(strftime('%m',sale_date) AS INT)+2)/3) AS q, SUM(s.quantity*p.unit_price) FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE strftime('%Y',sale_date)='2025' GROUP BY q ORDER BY q

question: Which supplier's products generated the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT su.name, SUM(s.quantity*p.unit_price) AS rev FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN suppliers su ON su.id=p.supplier_id GROUP BY su.id ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each category, how many units were purchased and how many were sold?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, COALESCE(SUM(b.bought),0), COALESCE(SUM(s.sold),0) FROM products p LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS bought FROM purchases GROUP BY product_id) b ON b.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS sold FROM sales GROUP BY product_id) s ON s.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.category

question: Products whose total units sold is above the average units sold per product.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS u FROM sales GROUP BY product_id) s ON s.product_id=p.id WHERE s.u > (SELECT AVG(u) FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity) AS u FROM sales GROUP BY product_id))

question: In which month of 2025 did we purchase the most units?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',purchase_date) AS m, SUM(quantity) AS u FROM purchases WHERE strftime('%Y',purchase_date)='2025' GROUP BY m ORDER BY u DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which category has the highest average margin percentage?
gold_sql: SELECT category, AVG((unit_price-unit_cost)*100.0/unit_price) AS m FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY m DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which products were sold in both 2025 and 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p WHERE p.id IN (SELECT product_id FROM sales WHERE strftime('%Y',sale_date)='2025') AND p.id IN (SELECT product_id FROM sales WHERE strftime('%Y',sale_date)='2026')

question: How many clothing products are there? (any capitalisation)
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE LOWER(category)='clothing'
